title: Smart Data Models - Agri Greenhouse
description: This entity contains a harmonised description of the conditions recorded within a generic greenhouse, a type of AgriParcel.

type.description: NGSI Entity Type. It has to be AgriGreenhouse

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

ownedBy.description: Relationship. Owner (Person or Organization) of the AgriGreenhouse

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Entity the greenhouse belongs to

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

hasAgriParcelParent.description: Relationship. Reference to the AgriParcel entity to which this entity relates

hasAgriParcelChildren.description: Relationship. Related sub AgriParcel records to which this entity relates

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

hasWeatherObserved.description: Relationship. Reference to the weather observation record current for this entity

hasWaterQualityObserved.description: Relationship. Reference to one or more water quality observation records current for this entity

relativeHumidity.description: Property. Model:'http://schema.org/Number'. The inside relative humidity, as a fraction between 0 and 1 representing 0% to 100%

leafTemperature.description: Property. Model:'http://schema.org/Number'. The average leaf temperature. Units:'degrees Celsius' (UN/CEFACT CEL)

co2.description: Property. Model:'http://schema.org/Number'. The measured interior CO2 concentration. Units:'milligrams per litre' (UN/CEFACT M1)

dailyLight.description: Property. Model:'http://schema.org/Number'. Daily accumulated light. Units:'kW per square metre'

drainFlow.description: Property. Model:'http://schema.org/Number'. The observed drain flow rate. Units:'litres per second'

maxValue.description: Maximum value of the drain flow

minValue.description: Minimum value of the drain flow

unitText.description: Description of the units of the drain flow

hasDevice.description: Relationship. Model:'http://schema.org/URL'. Reference to the IoT devices associated with this greenhouse i.e. sensors, controls
